Ben (Glacier AI): Hi team — we want to onboard a private fine-tuned summarization model to Redwood Private. It will process PHI, so we need PHI isolation, KMS/HSM integration, and pre/post inference redaction. Also want hallucination evals and SLA. Target launch: ~4 weeks. Who should I work with?
Sara (CS): @Ben welcome! I'll own intake. Quick Qs: is this BYO artifacts (S3) or do you want Redwood to fetch? license + training data summary?
Ben (Glacier AI): BYO artifacts in our S3. License: commercial-permissive. Training data includes internal clinical notes (PHI).
Ethan (Solutions): FYI we can do Private with customer-managed VPC + KMS. Recommend Dedicated capacity for throughput and isolation. We'll want a canary strategy and fallback model.
Maya (ML-Ops): Ben — what model format (pt/ggml), size, LoRA/adapter usage, and KV-cache needs? Also expected p95 latency / tokens per request?
Ben (Glacier AI): HuggingFace pt w/ LoRA, ~13GB checkpoint. KV cache required. Target p95 <= 400ms for ~512 tokens.
Maya (ML-Ops): 13GB PT is feasible. With LoRA we can do a lighter footprint but need to verify adapters. Quantization could reduce memory; we'll run an internal perf matrix. We also need your eval prompts + golden refs for hallucination checks.
Ben (Glacier AI): We'll upload eval set (~2k prompts) to S3. Requirement: hallucination rate < 2% on clinical QA; plus a PHI redaction filter for outputs.
Carlos (Security): @Ben @Sara need executed DPA and confirmation of KMS config (customer-managed key, HSM-backed preferred). Logs retention 90d, audit hooks required. Confirm that inference artifacts never leave customer VPC unless explicitly allowed.
Sara (CS): I'll start the intake ticket and send DPA link. @deploy-bot please create intake ticket for this onboarding.
deploy-bot: ✅ Ticket CS-2104 created. Intake owner: Sara. Tags: private-deploy, PHI, BYO-model.
Ethan (Solutions): Proposed plan: 1) artifact & license verification 2) smoke eval (subset) 3) staging private deployment with canary (10%) 4) gradual rollout with monitoring & fallback. Timeline: 2–3 weeks after artifacts + signed DPA.
Ben (Glacier AI): That timeline works. I'll add our SME Linh to the thread and upload S3 path today.
Sara (CS): Great — Ben please share S3 path and a contact (Linh). I'll DM the DPA link. Maya will queue up the eval run once we have the data. Carlos, can you confirm estimated time for security sign-off?
Carlos (Security): I'll review the DPA & KMS notes today; expect clearance in ~48 hours barring surprises. Also need to run tokenization review for PHI masking.
Maya (ML-Ops): One more ask — include a small reproducibility snippet (model config + tokenizer) so we can reproduce locally. Example snippet ok: `from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer`
Ethan (Solutions): Recommend setting an automatic fallback model (e.g., open-summarizer-7b) and an anomaly alert if hallucination > 1.5x baseline.
Ben (Glacier AI): Good call. Please add me to rollout channel and CC Linh (linh@glacier.ai). Thanks all.
Sara (CS): Added. Next steps: Ben upload + sign DPA; Maya run eval; Carlos security review; Ethan prep canary plan. I'll update ticket CS-2104 with milestones. :thumbsup:
Ben (Glacier AI): Thanks — will send S3 link in 30m.
